usageTipStart: To ensure the success rate of verification string monitoring and forwarding, please implement the following tips:
usageTip1: 1. Be sure to use a dedicated smartphone and a dedicated MSISDN (mobile number).
usageTip2: 2. Please place the device in a suitable location to keep the network and communication signals good.
usageTip3(rich): ${n}. Please keep the device connected to the charging cable for a long time and turn on the "${noLockScreen}" function. (Due to the differences in device manufacturers, please query the network or consult the device manufacturer for specific operations. Generally, you need to enter the developer mode to set)
usageTip4: 4. Try not to open other applications on this dedicated device, and do not install applications such as WeChat, WhatsApp, Facebook, Delta, Twitter, etc.
usageTip5: 5. When the DSMS verification access terminal App is working, please put the application at the forefront of the screen.
usageTip6: 6. When the system pops up SMS monitoring authorization, please click Allow.
usageTipEnd: If the monitoring and forwarding success rate is too low due to various reasons, the system will cancel or suspend the verifier's qualification according to the algorithm rules.
iHaveReadAndFollowed: I have read and followed the above precautions
